intent: You operate AS 65000 at an exchange. AS 65024 at 192.0.2.24 may send at most 2000 prefixes: warn at 75 percent, tear down above the limit and wait an hour before retrying. Reject shared carrier-grade NAT space.

name: Peer-Group Inheritance

intent: You operate AS 65000. Two customer sessions, 192.0.2.25 and 192.0.2.200, both belong to AS 65025 and share one template named CUSTOMERS. Put the prefix ceiling of 50 with an 80 percent warning on that template so both sessions inherit it. Reject multicast space.
